messages:
anika: Heads-up team: planning a base-image rebuild to remove setuid binaries and tighten runtime capabilities. We'll also rotate the image signer to the HSM-backed key and need RBAC changes for builder/signing service accounts. Target window: next Thu maintenance. Thoughts?

priya: +1. Please list the SAs that will lose wide perms so I can prepare scoped roles. Also we need immutable audit links that map old_key -> new_key and include build-id + sbom URL.

kevin: On signer rotation: the new key lives in our HSM (awskms). We'll need to update the cosign signer config on the signing deployment and the cluster image policy. Draft migration flow:

```
# dry-run verification
OLD_KEY_ID=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/old
NEW_KEY_ID=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/new
for img in $(cat canary-list.txt); do
  cosign verify --key $OLD_KEY_ID $img || echo "VERIFY_FAIL $img"
done
# update deployment env and trigger rolling restart
kubectl patch deploy signer --namespace infra -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"signer-key":"$NEW_KEY_ID"}}}}}'
```

kevin: I'll push a scripted dry-run and a signing job that emits a JSON audit record with fields: old_key, new_key, image_digest, build_id, sbom_link, actor. Registry will store the audit artifact.

sec-bot: Automated note: created ticket SEC-9142 for signer rotation + image hardening coordination. Assignees: @kevin @priya @anika. Due: next Wed.

tom: Runtime note: some infra sidecars assume files owned by root. We should run a userns-remap test on canaries and add a pipeline step to fail builds with suid/sgid bits. I can add a quick Trivy plugin for suid detection.

priya: RBAC list (draft):
- infra:builder-sa -> remove cluster-admin, grant registry:push, build:read
- signing:signer-sa -> restrict to kms:encrypt/decrypt + s3:put-object for audit artifacts
- registry:sync-sa -> read-only on images, no cluster role
I'll dump current rolebindings and post in ticket.

anika: Fallback policy during cutover? Prefer admission controller acceptance for both keys for a 30m window, with strict audit (who/why) and auto-escalation if >10 fails. If not possible, fallback to rollback.

kevin: Admission controller can accept multiple key IDs for a short window via feature flag. I'll open a PR in infra to add allowlist: [old_key, new_key] and a TTL param.

registry-bot: Canary repo populated: registry.redwood.internal/canary-rotation (images: 5).

priya: Compliance: retention for signer/audit records = 1 year; need searchability (timestamp, signer_key, image_digest, build_id, sbom). Will coordinate with Legal.

anika: Timeline proposal:
- Tue: rolebinding audit + PRs open
- Wed AM: canary dry-run + userns tests in staging
- Thu maintenance: prod cutover with admission-fallback on for 30m
- Fri: verification and closeout

kevin: Action items:
- add migration + dual-sign canary job (kevin)
- admission controller flag + staging PR (kevin, tom)
- RBAC changes + rolebinding cleanup (priya)
- suid/sgid scan + userns canary test (tom)
- audit retention policy draft (anika)

priya: Quick Q: do we need to update image verification on Dedicated clusters too? They pull images from the same registry but have different admission controllers.

anika: Yes — include dedicated in the rollout plan. We'll coordinate with infra on config sync.

kevin: I'll open INF PRs and link them in SEC-9142. Expect a dry-run script in infra/signing/ by EOD Tue.

anika: Thanks. Keep updates here for major blockers; use SEC-9142 for step-level tracking. :white_check_mark:
